description:
Retry a rejected invoice after the data that caused the rejection
was fixed.

Takes the local invoice_id, not the access key: a rejected document
never got one. Consumes a credit like a new issuance, so it takes
an idempotency_key for the same reason issue_invoice does. An
authorized invoice is corrected or cancelled, never reissued.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

idempotency_key.description: One per business event, e.g. order-1042. Sent as an HTTP header: printable ASCII up to 255, no leading or trailing space.

invoice_id.description: The local invoice id (a UUID), as list_invoices and issue_invoice return it. Not the access key.

name: reissue_invoice

outputSchema.description: One document, as the fiscal API describes it.

access_key.description: The authorizer's key. Absent while the document is not authorized.

id.description: Local id. Use it for reissue and for submissions, and when a document was rejected and has no key.
